I've always had success with the paper towel and baggie method. Basically, put seeds on damp paper towel and put that in a ziploc bag. You want the seeds between the bag and paper towel, don't cover the seeds on both sides with the paper. You should be able to see the seeds in the bag, and place that side down someplace warm inside. You want that side down so when it sprouts a root it tries to grow down into the plastic bag rather than the paper towel. This makes it easier to pick off and move to a starting pot without injuring the root because it's growing into the paper. Give them a look every other day until you see roots sprouting and then plant those right away. Don't let the root get long in the bag.
